proposal.description: The clamp of a ceiling at or past max_on_limit waits for a PWM falling edge, treated like a ceiling update that must not land mid-pulse, but SS_done is still raised on the clock the target is found.
proposal.reason: If max_on_limit is lowered below the ramping ceiling in S_SS, SS_done rises at once while max_on_counts stays above the limit until a falling edge. The supervisor then moves to S_RUN, where the ceiling is held, so max_on_counts can stay above max_on_limit for all of S_RUN.

proposal.description: A ceiling found above a lowered max_on_limit is handled like an aborted ramp and sent back to the MIN_ON_CNT floor to re-ramp, instead of being clamped to the limit and finishing.
proposal.reason: When max_on_limit is lowered below the ceiling during S_SS, max_on_counts drops to the floor instead of to the new limit, and SS_done does not rise until the ramp climbs back up to the limit. That is many step windows late. A normal ramp that reaches the limit by equality is unchanged.
